title: Reading and repairing PostgreSQL plans
brief: Repair a PostgreSQL plan using measured cardinality, work and workload stability.
outcomes: Interpret EXPLAIN ANALYZE without mistaking its counters
Test statistics, access paths and prepared-plan repairs under skew
entry: General execution plans and PostgreSQL storage/index methods.

heading.title: The native plan
heading.brief: Trace a shop report through EXPLAIN with actual rows, loops, buffers and timing; account for instrumentation and execution of modifying statements.

heading.title: Skew and statistics
heading.brief: Use proposed unequal shop sizes to expose correlation and distinct-count errors; test ANALYZE and extended statistics where applicable.

heading.title: Prepared plans
heading.brief: Compare tenant-sensitive parameter values under custom and generic plans; identify the actual plan mode before attributing a regression to caching.

heading.title: A comparable repair
heading.brief: Measure query shape, indexes and memory changes against one fixed workload; report elapsed time, work, spills and effects on other parameter values.
